statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-6089 affects net/http servers configured to accept unencrypted (h2c) HTTP/2 connections. This finding is on zot.lab.localhost:8080/lab/sbom-jobs, this lab's own SBOM-generation job image -- a one-shot batch job with no HTTP server of any kind, confirmed by reading the actual source (phase3-inventory/jobs/sbom_generate.py, sbom_rescan.py): no http.Server, no net/http import, no listener anywhere in the job's code path; it only makes outbound connections to Postgres, MinIO, and the registry. This is the one image, of the 14 affected by this CVE in the Phase 6 self-scan, whose full source is this repo's own and was actually read line by line for this triage -- the other 13 (Grafana, Kyverno's four controllers, CoreDNS, Traefik, MinIO, etc.) are real upstream projects whose HTTP-server configuration was not independently verified for this pass and remain untriaged (see phase6-self-scan/README.md's VEX-triage section).
